cn.t: Nottage's timely drama powerfully examines working-class America's economic collapse with empathy and urgency, though some critics find it heavy on exposition and predictability. Strong ensemble work anchors this important, deeply felt exploration.

vs.sum: An intimate 299-seat black box space at Roundabout, offering an unusually close actor-audience experience unlike any other Broadway house. Sightlines and sound vary by configuration since staging changes per production. Comfort is adequate but unremarkable.

acc.note: Accessible by elevator only. Assistive listening devices available.
